scene.heading: BHAGAVAD GITA 2.47
tr: mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi
scene.en: But you have only the right to work, but none to the fruit of it. Let not the fruit of your action be your motive; nor be you enamored of inaction.

say: Krishna's answer is one line. You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of it.
